methods.title: Tracked-or-new content-seal selection
methods.failure_signature: The successful final builder used caught git-show failures to distinguish eleven new files from paths already present in immutable x2, producing noisy fatal child-process displays.
trigger_preconditions: mixed tracked and new content-seal inputs
methods.candidate_workaround: Build an exact tracked-path set once and select Git blobs or filesystem bytes without using failed child commands as control flow.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never use an expected failing Git command as the tracked-path discriminator in a successful evidence builder.
methods.rollback: Retain the successful first build and its displayed failures; correct only the future builder implementation and refresh derived byte metadata.

recommendations.text: Use an exact tracked-path set rather than caught failed Git reads when sealing mixed tracked and new files.
